claim: Generalized feedback geometry and query arity jointly determine the first finite-information Pareto frontier capable of stable oscillatory feedback.

canonical_ternary.interpretation: same minimum world count as binary but one fewer query/frontier obligation

quaternary_tradeoff.interpretation: query/frontier and world minima are incompatible

scope: finite deterministic unit-cost sensing with bounded query arity and local generalized feedback dynamics
novelty_boundary: No novelty claim for Pareto optimization, bounded-arity tree counting, or local complex-eigenvalue criteria; the contribution is their exact composition into a dynamical reachability frontier.
